idea-plugin.name: DotVVM
idea-plugin.description:
DotVVM support for JetBrains Rider: syntax highlighting, completion, navigation and validation for .dothtml, .dotmaster and .dotcontrol files.

The files are treated as an HTML superset, so the IDE's HTML, CSS and JavaScript support keeps working. Binding expressions are a language of their own, with completion of the kinds and of the members the data context actually has. Directives are highlighted, offered and navigable, and the errors a build would report show while editing - they come from DotVVM's own view compiler rather than from a guess.

Needs a .NET runtime on the machine, version 8 or newer. A language server ships with the plugin and is started as a separate process; Rider's own runtime is not used. With none found the editor still works and the status bar stays empty.

An unofficial plugin, written and maintained independently. It is neither affiliated with nor endorsed by Riganti, who make DotVVM.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.4.0

  • Completion inside a binding expression: an opening brace offers the kinds a file may use - value:, command:, staticCommand:, resource: - and after the colon come the members of the data context, which follows the view
  • A dot walks into whatever the expression evaluates to, however long the chain - Customer.Address.City, Items[0].Name
  • Which methods are offered depends on the kind of binding: one evaluated in the browser takes only what DotVVM can translate to JavaScript, one evaluated on the server takes the view model's own methods
  • Typing {{ writes the closing braces, and what is offered inside a binding is kept to what may be written there - no HTML tags, no Emmet abbreviations
  • Needs a project that has been built, the same as live validation and through the same process, so DOTVVM_LS_LIVE_VALIDATION=off switches it off as well

0.3.0

  • Live validation: the errors a build would report now show while editing - a mistyped property in a binding, an identifier the data context does not have, a value of the wrong type. The messages come from DotVVM's own view compiler
  • Saving compiles at once; typing waits half a second for the keystrokes to stop
  • Needs a project built on DotVVM 4.3.0 or newer; set DOTVVM_LS_LIVE_VALIDATION=off to switch it off

0.2.1

  • Completion offers the property families - Class-, Style-, Param- - on controls and on plain HTML elements alike
  • Cmd-click on a control tag opens the .dotcontrol file registered for it, or the class declaring it
  • A control read from the serialized configuration no longer loses what it inherits

0.2.0

  • Completion of a control's properties and of a directive's value - the view model type, a namespace, the path to a master page
  • Validation of the file header: a repeated or misspelt directive, a missing value, a type or master page that is not there
  • Server-side comments <%-- --%> are painted, parsed and produced as comments, between a tag's attributes as well
  • Cmd-click in a directive opens the type's source, or the project building the assembly named after the comma
  • Hover reports the properties of the project's own controls, markup controls included

0.1.0

  • Highlighting for binding expressions, including nested braces and quotes inside the expression
  • Directives: highlighting, name completion, navigation to the master page
  • Tag validation, control completion and navigation to the view model from the directive
  • A status bar indicator naming what the language server knows about the project
  • Suppression of messages the platform reports only because it does not know DotVVM
